meta-runner.name: Push and publish Multi Artifactory Docker Images
meta-runner.description: Create and publish Artifactory build and push multi docker images to it

param.name: ARTIFACTORY_DOCKER_IMAGES
param.spec: text description='Docker images to push (comma/semicolon-separated list of image:tag)' display='normal'

param.name: ARTIFACTORY_DOCKER_REPOSITORY
param.spec: text description='Artifactory Docker repository name' display='normal'

param.name: CONTAINER_ENGINE
param.spec: text description='Container engine to use (docker/podman, or comma-separated list - prefers podman)' display='normal'

runner.name: push multi docker images and publish build
